'''Sal''' was a miner who was part of the group working on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] for the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]]. The miners accidentally unearthed the burial site of a [[Xivhkalrainik's father|Kaleesh warrior]]. The son of the desecrated [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] was the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]], who in an act of revenge attacked Sal and his crew and killed everyone present.<ref>{{TORcite|Death Before Dishonor|Ilum}}</ref>
